author: La Jornada Editorial Board
meta_description: After decades of plundering the Riviera Maya coastline it was handed under neoliberal rule, U.S. firm Vulcan Materials tried to extort $1.9 billion from Mexico in a corporate tribunal built to favor companies like itself, and walked away with just $15 million. A resounding victory for Mexican sovereignty, though 35 U.S. Republicans are pressing Trump to keep the looting going, writes La Jornada's editorial board.
